name: コメンテーター
detailed_description:
You have been appointed as a commentator for the country's most popular news program, "NEWS SQUARE"!

Every day before the live broadcast, you will attend a meeting with the show's producer to discuss the news for the day. You will choose the news you want to comment on and your critique stance. Be mindful that the meeting time is limited. Capture the audience's attention, satisfy the program's sponsors, and solidify your position.

This news program covers a wide range of topics, from global conflicts to delicious ramen information. You might think that reporting on ramen shops is unnecessary, but in reality, ramen news attracts viewers' attention and pleases sponsors. What is the role of news reporting in this country? What is its purpose? These thoughts might cross your mind, but your task is to choose and critique the news. Your choices will impact those around you.

"Commentator" is a novel game where you become a commentator for a popular news program. By selecting the news to comment on and your critique stance, you will experience a manipulation of a public opinion and a changing world. During pre-broadcast meetings, you will choose the news and critique stance through point-and-click puzzles. Be careful, as the meeting time is limited. After the meeting, it's time for the live broadcast.

The world around you will change based on the reputation you earn from your live broadcasts. If your reputation is poor, you may be fired, but if you become popular, you might be welcomed no matter what you say. Let's see how public opinion is influenced by your choices.
